info.name: NetApp ONTAP REST Aggregates Network API

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Use * for all fields. Nested fields can be specified using dot notation (e.g., space.size).

params.name: max_records
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page

params.name: order_by
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by. Add 'desc' after a field name to sort in descending order (e.g., name desc).

items.docs: Retrieves a list of network interfaces (LIFs) across the cluster. Network interfaces provide data access and management connectivity for SVMs and the cluster.
